datasets.name: AbAMPdb
datasets.license: Repository LICENSE is MIT; website describes database access as free. Cite source publication.
datasets.note: ampdb-Final.csv contains 250 records (248 standard-amino-acid sequences, 237 unique exact sequences). MIC units are not specified in the export. Alternate ampdb-Final3.csv is headerless and ampdb-Final2.csv is a one-row fragment; do not treat them as independent clean datasets.
datasets.excluded_repository_file: data.json (application fixture contained unrelated account credential hashes; not needed for AMP analysis)
